description: Authoritative longitudinal record of RPM / Group Cycle workouts. Daily logs may contain a contextual exercise snapshot; use this file for RPM performance trends.

post_workout_feedback.issue: Left calf tightening / felt close to cramping during second-last exercise.
post_workout_feedback.trigger_pattern: More noticeable during racing-load / faster-cadence work; not noticed during heavy-load work.
post_workout_feedback.response: Slowed cadence until calf no longer felt tight.
post_workout_feedback.subsequent_response: No issue; able to push to about 80% without calf tightening.
post_workout_feedback.status_after_session: User reports calf was fine during subsequent mountain-climbing effort.

entries.source: User-confirmed completed RPM session; tracking/sync failure
entries.notes: Proper RPM session completed. Group Cycle Connect did not record/sync. Samsung Health also failed to update correctly. Watch cycling exercise was manually started 28:40 into class and covered roughly the final 20+ minutes, but phone did not sync the workout. User reports session was similar in effort to 2026-09-27. No performance metrics or calories copied from the prior workout; session retained as completed with metrics unavailable.

entries.source: Group Cycle Connect and Samsung Health screenshots
entries.notes: Group Cycle Connect: 49:40, 21 km, 579 kcal, 1048 moves, 165 W average, 462 W max, 69 rpm average cadence. Samsung Health was recorded as Other workout from 08:32, showing 45:04 total duration, 463 kcal, 140 bpm average heart rate and 168 bpm maximum heart rate. Group Cycle Connect metrics retained as the primary RPM performance record; Samsung Health heart-rate metrics retained as complementary data.

post_workout_feedback.user_feedback: Really struggled today, felt like I had no energy, and it was a real struggle to get through the session.
post_workout_feedback.performance_context: Despite feeling substantially more fatigued, average power was maintained at 165 W compared with 166 W on 2026-09-27.

entries.source: Group Cycle Connect and Samsung Health screenshots
entries.notes: Group Cycle Connect: 44:10, 20.3 km, 562 kcal, 1018 moves, 185 W average power, 325 W max power and 73 rpm average cadence. Samsung Health/Galaxy Watch3: 42:58 total duration, 449 kcal, 141 bpm average heart rate and 174 bpm maximum heart rate. Group Cycle Connect retained as the primary RPM performance record; Samsung Health heart-rate metrics retained as complementary data.

post_workout_feedback.user_feedback: Felt really good during the session, felt on top of it, pushed pretty hard and really enjoyed it.
post_workout_feedback.instructor_context: Lolita teaches the Tuesday session. User particularly enjoys her sessions and feels she pushes him harder.
post_workout_feedback.performance_context: Average power of 185 W was substantially higher than the 165 W recorded on 2026-10-04, while average cadence returned to 73 rpm.
